review.reviewNotes: Fifteen complete Moxie human poses. Hands stay clasped tightly at chest through takeoff and peak, then separate for a short one-hand release at frame10/tick21, followed by score and landing. Her adult identity, lavender eyes and ponytail/gold tie, purple/silver uniform and proportions remain consistent. No basketball in art; cleaned atlas reviewed.
